title: Runtime and Ratings
text:
We also want to see if there is a correlation between runtime and movie ratings, as shown by ?@fig-runtime-rating.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Runtime vs. IMDb Rating")
plt.show()

title: Budget and Revenue
text:
We want to see if there is a correlation between a movie’s budget and revenue. This is shown by ?@fig-budget-revenue

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(df["budget_musd"], df["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget")
plt.ylabel("Revenue")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()

title: The Bond Movies
text:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]

bond = bond.sort_values("year")

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue")
plt.title("James Bond Box Office Revenue")
plt.show()
